package_info.package_versions: Wallpapers Blur HD, Booster & Cleaner Pro (all versions with LeakerLocker)
package_info.why_malicious: The applications contain embedded ransomware code that abuses granted permissions to harvest personal data from the victim's device and then extorts the user by threatening to leak the data unless a ransom is paid.

execution_context.file_location: main application code (Wallpapers Blur HD / Booster & Cleaner Pro)

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At runtime, the code collects personal data from the device (contacts, photos, messages), sends it to a remote attacker-controlled server, and displays a ransom note threatening to leak the data unless payment is made.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Harvesting and exfiltrating personal data without user consent, followed by extortion, is a hallmark of ransomware and privacy-violating malware.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Normal applications do not collect and exfiltrate sensitive user data or threaten users with data leaks for ransom.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Backup applications may collect and upload user data, but only with explicit user consent and clear privacy policies.
key_indicators: Exfiltration of personal data to remote server
Display of ransom note demanding payment

attack_chain.action: User installs the malicious app from Google Play and grants requested permissions.
attack_chain.leads_to: App is able to access sensitive data.

attack_chain.action: App collects personal data (contacts, photos, messages, etc.) from the device.
App sends the harvested data to an attacker-controlled server.
attack_chain.leads_to: Attacker gains possession of sensitive user data.

attack_chain.action: App displays a ransom note threatening to leak the data unless payment is made.
attack_chain.leads_to: User is extorted for ransom payment.

behavioral_signatures: Mobile app collects and exfiltrates personal data (contacts, photos, messages) without user interaction
App displays ransom note threatening to leak data
Network communication to attacker-controlled servers after data collection
file_indicators: Apps named 'Wallpapers Blur HD' or 'Booster & Cleaner Pro' with excessive permissions
Presence of code accessing contacts, photos, SMS, and sending data over the network
network_indicators: Outbound connections to known attacker infrastructure or suspicious remote servers immediately after installation or on app start
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for mobile applications that request broad permissions and subsequently access and transmit personal data to external servers, especially if followed by a ransom demand. Flag apps that display ransom notes or threaten to leak user data. Use network monitoring to detect exfiltration of sensitive data to untrusted domains.
